requirement.original: Fix two CSS bugs in BashView inline preview (message list, not sidebar). Bug 1: Long output — horizontal scrollbar overlaps with '+N more lines' text. Bug 2: Short output — bottom rounded corners look bad.
requirement.clarified: Fix two CSS layout bugs in BashView.tsx caused by borderBottomLeftRadius/borderBottomRightRadius/overflow:hidden being on the outer container that wraps both ScrollView and moreContainer. Move radius to the appropriate bottom-most element conditionally.
requirement.what: Fix CSS layout bugs in BashView inline preview
requirement.why: Visual artifacts: scrollbar overlapping text indicator on long output, and ugly bottom corners on short output

included: Conditional radius application based on presence of moreContainer

success_criteria: Long output: '+N more lines' text fully visible, no overlap with scrollbar
Short output: bottom corners render cleanly rounded without artifacts
Terminal background fills edge-to-edge within ToolView card
constraints: Must maintain negative margin technique for edge-to-edge fill
Inner radius 11 maps to outer ToolView radius 8 accounting for padding offset

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Bug 1: scrollbar overlaps '+N more lines' text. Bug 2: bottom corners look bad on short output.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Commit a529bf91 added borderBottomLeftRadius/borderBottomRightRadius/overflow:hidden to the container View that wraps BOTH the ScrollView and the moreContainer. This causes: (1) overflow:hidden on container clips/interferes with ScrollView scrollbar positioning relative to moreContainer, (2) border radius on the container doesn't cleanly round the ScrollView's terminal content when it's the last child (no moreContainer).
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: To visually round the bottom corners of the terminal block to match ToolView card's borderRadius: 8
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Applying radius and overflow:hidden to a container that has two children (ScrollView + moreContainer) creates conflicts: the radius clips the wrong element's content, and the ScrollView's internal scrollbar positioning fights with the moreContainer below it.

context.recent_commits: a529bf91 Auto-commit (added border radius to BashView), 64d02aca fix: truncate long bash commands, 5c7a234f fix: bash inline preview clean rewrite

development_approach.strategy: Remove borderBottomLeftRadius, borderBottomRightRadius, and overflow:hidden from the container style. Instead, conditionally apply bottom radius: (1) When extraLines > 0 (moreContainer shown): apply borderBottomLeftRadius/borderBottomRightRadius to moreContainer. (2) When extraLines === 0 (no moreContainer): wrap ScrollView or apply radius to a wrapper View that is the last child. Keep overflow:hidden on container since ToolView parent already has it, or apply it selectively.
development_approach.validation_approach: Visual verification via Playwright on dev.life-ai.app — test both long output (with +N more lines) and short output bash tool calls on desktop and mobile viewports

research_findings.reason: Straightforward CSS bug fix with clear root cause in a single file
